description_en: We have premises for sale located in Selvia. • Total area: 401 m² (gross) • Positioned on the first floor • Currently divided into 7 functional offices • New building, with elevator • Glass facade and 360° panoramic view • Dedicated entrance for the environment • Regular mortgage documentation • Very good investment opportunity • Central and easily accessible area • Suitable for various activities: office, clinic, aesthetics, service center, etc. For more information, contact us.
